assign_training.q: How do I assign a training course to employees?
assign_training.a: Navigate to Training Hub > Course Builder or Assignments. Select the module, pick the target property or department, set the completion deadline, and submit the assignment rule.

access_my_training.q: Where do I find my assigned training courses?
access_my_training.a: Go to the Training section from your sidebar. Under "My Courses", you will see your active modules, upcoming deadlines, and progress percentage.

submit_request.q: How do I submit a time-off or shift exchange request?
submit_request.a: Open the Requests Hub from your navigation menu. Click "New Request", choose the category (Shift Exchange, Leave, Equipment), fill the required dates and justification, and click Submit.

approve_requests.q: Where do I review and approve pending team requests?
approve_requests.a: Managers can view the approval queue under Requests > Approvals. Review the employee request, check shift coverage, and choose to Approve, Reject, or Return with comments.

sop_publishing.q: How do I draft and publish a new Standard Operating Procedure?
sop_publishing.a: Navigate to Knowledge Studio > Create SOP. Fill in the title, department category, bilingual text (English & Arabic), and submit for editorial review and publication.

user_invitation.q: How do I invite new hotel staff members to the intranet?
user_invitation.a: Go to Admin > User Directory. Click "Invite User", specify their email address, property, department, and assigned organizational role.

profile_language.q: How do I switch the platform language between Arabic and English?
profile_language.a: Click the Language Switcher in the top header or navigate to Profile Settings. Choose between English and Arabic (العربية). The layout will automatically adapt to RTL format.

download_certificates.q: Where do I view and download my completed course certificates?
download_certificates.a: After achieving a passing score (>80%) on a course assessment, digital certificates are available under Training > Certificates or from your profile page.
